verse.meaning_english: to protect,to go, to desire, to wish, to love, to please, to satisfy, to enter, to hear, to own, to order, to command, to request, to beg, to act, to glow, to shine, to obtain, to hug, to embrace, to kill, to hurt, to grow, to gain power

commentaries.content: ' अव - रक्षणे गतौ कान्तौ प्रीतौ तृप्तौ द्युतौ श्रुतौ । प्राप्तौ श्लेषेर्थने वेशे भागे वृद्धौ ग्रहे वधे । स्वाम्यर्थेवगमे कामे कृतौ ' इति वोपदेवः ।
